description:
Start a paid Higgsfield Genjutsu Restyle video (POST /api/v1/higgsfield/genjutsu/restyle/generate).

Redraws the whole source video in one chosen style; motion, camera and the source audio stay.
Needs video_url (a source video of 4-30 seconds) and preset_id (an id from
list_higgsfield_restyle_styles). Optional: image_urls (up to 5 character photos), prompt,
resolution 480p, 720p or 1080p. Media is a public HTTPS URL or the key/url returned by
upload_media. Run estimate_higgsfield_restyle first and pass its cost_rub as max_cost_rub.
Optional webhook_url (public HTTPS) is called when the video completes or fails; otherwise
follow the job with get_video. While it is still queued cancel_higgsfield_video cancels it
and refunds the charge.
name: create_higgsfield_restyle
